status: Wave 2 grammar: three statuses, two hooks; skill modifiers live in items.json (D-014), skills are learned (D-016)

chill.design_purpose: Chill buildup per hit comes from the applying skill; crossing buildup_max freezes. Decay is slow (6/s) so buildup is a resource that survives a cooldown: at the orb's 1.2 s cooldown a bare caster freezes a whelp on the third orb, two with Deep Frost. Frozen mobs are solid: your damage builds walls. boss_buildup_multiplier is the day-one status-resistance rule so bosses cannot be permafrozen (skill-grammar.md risk list).

ignite.design_purpose: Fire's status: a burning mob takes damage_per_s for duration_s (24 fire over four seconds at base - most of a whelp). Three Ember Bolts ignite; Kindling makes it two; Burn Damage and Ignite Duration scale the burn, not the hit. Re-igniting a burning mob refreshes the timer rather than stacking.

bleed.design_purpose: Physical's status: slow damage while the mob stands, moving_multiplier times that while it walks - the chasing train pays for chasing. Two Rends open a wound; Serration makes it one plus a strike. Hemorrhage scales the tick. At base a walking mob takes 45 over the bleed, a standing one 15.

shatter.design_purpose: The combo maker: hitting a FROZEN enemy with any skill carrying a trigger tag (every attack - Area Strike, Heavy Strike, Rend) shatters it: an execute plus a cold nova at the corpse. Novas shatter other frozen enemies in radius, so a frozen train cascades down its own line. Spells do not shatter: cold spells set up, attacks cash in. executes_boss false means a frozen boss takes the nova damage and thaws instead of dying - the freeze window is the reward, not a one-shot; flip it (or gate it per-tier) in the mob pass if elites want executes. A skill tagged shatter (the Shatter spell) triggers it too: the one spell that cashes in.

proliferate.design_purpose: Fire's chain reaction: when a burning mob dies, every mob within radius_m receives spread_buildup ignite (100 = it catches fire outright). A dense pack burns down from one kill; Wildfire Reach widens the radius. The mirror of shatter's cascade, for the fire sentence. Boss resistance applies through the receiving mob's usual multiplier.

design_purpose: The Wave 2 grammar (docs/systems/skill-grammar.md): statuses and on-event hooks. The tag-targeted modifiers that scale them (forks, buildup, durations, radii, damage, cooldown recovery) are items.json modifiers since D-014, carried by gear; the F1-F3 debug toggles activate one at its tier-1 maximum. Effect keys: add_* is flat, increased_* sums additively within its bucket, more_* multiplies. Hooks trigger by tag, never by skill id, so a page found tomorrow joins the combos it is tagged for.
